question: What restriction governs eating food in relation to Lord Sadāśiva?
premises: Food may be offered to the deity before consumption.
Lord Sadāśiva is the recipient of the offering.
Consuming unoffered food is subject to prohibition.
inference: One should not eat food that has not been offered to Lord Sadāśiva.
plain_english: One should not eat anything that has not been offered to Lord Sadāśiva.
